requiredBehavior: Block before calculation or posting and do not infer a rate, account, recoverability, VAT box, or fallback treatment.

scenarios.description: Any 12% sale, purchase, acquisition, or import, including restaurant and accommodation classifications.
Any 6% sale, purchase, acquisition, or import, including the temporary food-rate period.
Any VAT-exempt supply or small-business exemption.
Any goods or service sale to another EU VAT territory, including EC Sales List obligations.
Any EU acquisition of goods or services and associated self-assessed VAT.
Exports and services supplied outside Sweden.
Services purchased from outside the EU VAT territory.
Imports of goods and fields 50 and 60-62.
Domestic or cross-border reverse-charge sales or purchases.
Partial input-VAT recovery, mixed activity, private use, or a deduction limitation.
VAT conversion from a document currency other than SEK.
One Stop Shop transactions or account 2670 behavior.
Voluntary VAT treatment for property rental.
Middleman purchase or sale in triangular EU trade.
Any transaction without an exact supported document, line, registration, and evidence match.
